address: 82 Cu Xa Nguyen Van Troi Street, Phu Nhuan Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 700000, Vietnam
bio: Opened decades ago, this modest spot serving Huế comfort food in a casual, welcoming setting has a loyal following. The bún bò Huế features tender beef in a light and soothing soup; bánh bèo and nem nướng are ordered by nearly every table. A family atmosphere reigns in the clean, quiet space.
